title_idea: EU imposes provisional safeguard measures on grain-oriented electrical steel imports from 18 September 2026
keyword: EU provisional safeguard measures grain-oriented electrical steel 2026 importer cost
angle: This article lets importers of grain-oriented electrical steel, laminations, cores and transformers with incorporated cores confirm the new applicable import rules and adjust their sourcing and pricing accordingly to avoid unexpected extra costs.
